title: Large-scale Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining with Feature Fusion and Keyword-to-Caption Augmentation
layout_note: Top panel (pretraining) is a two-tower layout: audio column at left with two length-dependent branches, text column at right, meeting in a similarity matrix at bottom-right; below two dashed rules, two compact one-row pipelines for zero-shot and supervised classification.
grouping: Three stacked panels separated by full-width dashed horizontal rules with centred titles ('Zero-shot Audio Classification', 'Supervised Audio Classification'). In the top panel, column headings 'Audio Waveforms' and 'Text Data', and a beige-tinted dashed frame labelled 'Audio Encoder' around both audio branches; a brace labelled 'Finetune' spans the supervised pipeline.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered rectangles with thin outlines and pastel fills: grey (Repeat + Pad, Mel-FilterBank), blue (Conv2D, Merge Conv2D, Attention Feature Fusion, Keyword-to-Caption Augmentation, Projection Layers), lavender (Other Encoder Layers), orange (MLP Layer, MLP), cream (Text Encoder, Audio Encoder), white (Captions, Labels). Waveforms are images in thin frames; the similarity matrix is a grey grid with pink diagonal cells marked 1.
proposed_highlight: No explicit 'ours' marker: the feature-fusion branch (Merge Conv2D, Attention Feature Fusion) and the Keyword-to-Caption Augmentation box are blue, but blue also fills the routine Conv2D and Projection Layers.
lesson: Show variable-length handling on the data itself: cut the long waveform into colour-framed chunks tied to their source spans by matching-colour dashed lines, beside the short clip's repeat-and-pad branch.
notes: Venue from the paper text (acknowledgement mentions 'the ICASSP 2023 proceedings'); year 2023 = that venue year (arXiv preprint 2022). Method name CLAP from the title's acronym. flow 'mixed': towers run top to bottom, the lower panels left to right. Waveform images are embedded (photo_share).

arrangement.units: three panels stacked top to bottom, separated by dashed horizontal rules: pretraining (audio column with a beige dashed 'Audio Encoder' frame, text column, similarity matrix at bottom-right), zero-shot classification, supervised classification, each lower panel titled at its top
arrangement.inputs_as: a short and a long waveform image under 'Audio Waveforms'; white 'Captions' and 'Labels' boxes under 'Text Data'; symbolic inputs (Audio X^a, classes {C_1..C_M}) in the lower panels
arrangement.losses_at: the contrastive objective is the similarity matrix at the bottom-right of the top panel, entered by the audio MLP's arrow from the left and the text MLP from above
arrangement.shared: Audio Encoder, Text Encoder and MLP reappear in the lower panels as small boxes with the same fills

taxonomy.task: language-audio contrastive pretraining with feature fusion for variable-length audio and keyword-to-caption augmentation; zero-shot and supervised audio classification

insights.structure: Audio tower on the left and text tower on the right descend to a similarity matrix at bottom-right; two thin downstream panels under dashed rules reuse the same encoder and MLP boxes.
insights.data: Audio is drawn as waveform images, the long clip split into three coloured-frame 10-sec chunks plus a grey downsampled clip; embeddings are labelled E_i^a (rows) and E_j^t (columns) on the matrix.
insights.emphasis: Nothing is marked as new; the fusion branch is the only audio path with extra blocks, and the matrix's pink diagonal is the only saturated pattern.
insights.flow: Each tower reads downward on short vertical arrows; the audio MLP's arrow runs right into the matrix rows while the text MLP sits directly above its columns.
insights.avoid: Blue fill mixes the new blocks with routine ones (Conv2D, Projection Layers), and the short branch's Conv2D output takes a long L-shaped wire down to Other Encoder Layers.

core.what: audio tower and text tower meet at a square similarity matrix: the audio MLP's arrow enters the rows E^a from the left, the text MLP sits above the columns E^t, positive pairs as pink diagonal cells marked 1

relations.form: a similarity matrix at bottom-right, rows = audio embeddings entered from the left, columns = text embeddings from above, pink '1' cells on the diagonal
the long waveform image is cut into three colour-framed 10-sec chunks and a grey downsampled clip, each chunk tied to its span by a matching-colour dashed line
inside the dashed Audio Encoder frame the long-audio branch stacks Mel-FilterBank, Conv2D, Merge Conv2D, Attention Feature Fusion, and the short branch's line joins it at Other Encoder Layers
the original Captions and the augmented Captions (Labels through Keyword-to-Caption Augmentation) converge by elbow lines on one Text Encoder
pretraining panel on top, then zero-shot and supervised classification as compact one-row panels below dashed rules, reusing the encoder and orange MLP boxes

channels.colour: module fill by kind, mostly: orange = MLP projection (same in every panel), grey = fixed preprocessing, lavender = remaining encoder layers, cream = encoders in the lower panels, but blue covers both the new fusion/augmentation blocks and routine Conv2D/Projection Layers; frame colours on the audio chunks (purple, blue, red, grey) mark which span of the long clip a chunk is - a second meaning; pink = positive pair in the matrix
channels.shape: rectangles = modules, white boxes = text data, framed waveform images = audio data, grid = similarity matrix
channels.line: solid arrows = data flow; coloured dashed lines = chunk-to-source correspondence; a hooked line labelled 'match' in the zero-shot panel; a brace marks the finetuned span
channels.frame: beige dashed frame = the Audio Encoder unit; full-width dashed rules = panel boundaries

quality.strengths: The two towers face each other across a CLIP-style matrix with labelled rows and columns, so what is compared is drawn; variable-length handling is drawn on real waveform images with colour-matched chunks; the orange MLP vocabulary is taught once and reused compactly in the downstream panels.
quality.weaknesses: Blue fill does not separate the new blocks from routine ones; the short branch's Conv2D output detours down a long L-shaped wire; the zero-shot 'match' is a hooked line rather than the two embeddings facing each other; the text column joins its two caption sources by elbows.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
